g.text: Scenario: Capture an agent run context
g.title: Trigger: An operator starts an agent-assisted repository run. Preconditions: Repository and task source resolve.; Worktree can be isolated. Controls: run_id; base_sha; head_sha; checkpoint_id Outputs: Context packet and evidence envelope bound to the run. Failures: Unknown checkpoint blocks context capture.; Integrity or schema validation fails. Signals: Context digest.; Evidence validation result.; Run failure reason.

ID: tabellio_cli Responsibility: Orchestrate the Git-native agent workflow and evidence contracts. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js State variables: run_id; worktree; head_sha Invariants: Run state is bound to an exact repository and revision. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: git_store Responsibility: Store commits, refs, diffs, branches, and isolated worktrees. Owner: Repository operator Runtime: Git State variables: commit_sha; ref; worktree Invariants: Commit IDs are immutable. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: entire_source Responsibility: Provide checkpoint and session metadata for agent-assisted work. Owner: Entire Runtime: Entire CLI State variables: checkpoint_id; session_id; checkpoint_digest Invariants: Checkpoint identity is preserved. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/entire-ledger-provider.mjs:1#EntireLedgerProvider @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_packet Responsibility: Bind task, actor, exact refs, changed files, and checkpoint metadata. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Versioned JSON State variables: base_sha; head_sha; merge_base_sha; context_digest Invariants: Integrity excludes the self-integrity field from its hash. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: evidence_store Responsibility: Record commands, checks, approvals, artifacts, and side-effect policy. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Versioned JSON State variables: run_id; head_sha; checks; approvals Invariants: Protected action classes default to deny. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca
